Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacy evaluates hazardous handling even when the drug is not federally scheduled.
A pharmacy separates regulated hazardous waste handling from its ordinary controlled-substance accounting.
A pharmacy selects chemotherapy gloves meeting the applicable performance standard for the task.
A 503B facility maintains applicable cGMP obligations for its outsourcing operation.
A facility uses an alcohol wipe in place of the required hazardous-residue removal process and treats the surface as decontaminated.

method: TF-IDF log TF cosine on full stem plus all option text; ranking discovery only, not semantic verdict

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy is appropriately licensed for a proposed compounding activity and plans to compound a drug that is hazardous under the applicable standards. Which principles should the pharmacist apply? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Continue to follow the sterile or non-sterile compounding requirements applicable to the preparation.
Apply the current hazardous-drug handling requirements that govern the hazardous ingredient and compounding process.
Treat hazardous-drug status as replacing all other compounding requirements.
Ignore hazardous-drug controls if the prescription is patient-specific.
Use the fact that the pharmacy has a compounding license as proof that no additional hazardous-drug operational controls apply.

original_read_snapshot.stem: While resolving a claim, a pharmacist learns of a quality-related event at 3 p.m. Monday. When must the initial event documentation be completed?

choices.text: Document by the end of the next business day.
Wait until the monthly CQI meeting.
Within 24 hours after the pharmacist discovered or was told of the event.
Start the clock only after the patient confirms harm.
Use the seven-business-day serious-event reporting deadline.

Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist discovers that an improper warfarin dispensing caused a patient to be hospitalized, and the facts meet the serious-injury reporting criteria in 247 CMR 20.02(1). Which statements correctly distinguish the duties triggered by this same event? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: The pharmacist’s initial QRE documentation remains subject to the 24-hour discovery-or-notification clock.
The seven-business-day Board reporting period is measured from the date the prescription was originally written.
The manager of record must report the qualifying improper dispensing within seven business days of discovery of the related serious injury or death.
Completing the QRE record eliminates the separate serious-event report because both rules concern the same dispensing error.
The event can trigger both CQI documentation and the separate serious-event reporting pathway because the rules have different purposes and clocks.

original_read_snapshot.stem: Two applicants seek Massachusetts pharmacist licensure by examination. One graduated from an ACPE-accredited school; the other graduated from a non-approved foreign school. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Both applicants must have completed a pharmacy internship in accordance with 247 CMR 8.01(1).
The foreign graduate must have received official FPGEC certification from NABP.
Both applicants must be 18 years of age or older by the scheduled examination date.
FPGEC certification relieves the foreign graduate of the internship requirement.
The ACPE-accredited graduate is exempt from the good moral character requirement.

choices.text: The employer's offer establishes the applicant's licensing eligibility.
The foreign-school pathway requires the specified FPGEC certification evidence.
FPGEC certification also establishes completion of every internship requirement.
Graduation waives the minimum age for the examination pathway.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician's license has been expired for 26 months. The technician submits the renewal form and fees, but the Board has not renewed the license or decided whether to impose additional conditions. The pharmacy wants the technician to begin work under direct pharmacist supervision. Which statement is most accurate?

choices.text: Submitting the form and fees restores the license provisionally while the Board reviews the application.
Direct pharmacist supervision may permit practice during the renewal review despite the expired license.
A lapse exceeding two years automatically requires a specified national technician examination before renewal.
The technician cannot practice until renewal; because the lapse exceeded two years, additional Board conditions may apply.
A lapse exceeding two years permanently bars renewal of the technician license.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A graduate receives passing examination results on Friday. The Massachusetts pharmacist license has not yet been issued, but the employer schedules independent verification duties for Saturday.

Case B: An applicant pays all required fees while the Board requests missing documentation. The applicant asks whether payment permits practice during processing.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Payment does not replace completion and approval of the licensing process.
A graduate with an intern license may perform final pharmacist verification independently.
Passing both examinations authorizes practice while license issuance is pending.
The Board must treat an incomplete application as approved once fees are accepted.
